findings.title: Tracker dossier close loses the exact provider opener
findings.repro: Open tracker-connections.html at 354x792; click connected-card[data-key=mal]; press Escape. Focus lands on Preferences, not the MAL card.
findings.expected: Restore the exact visible enabled provider card which invoked the dossier, as approved QML closeDossier does.
findings.cause: render falls back to Preferences after the focused dossier button disappears. returnFocus records only action and is not used to restore provider identity.
findings.recommendation: Preserve action plus provider key (or stable opener identity) and restore it on all dossier close paths; check nested dialogs separately. Do not port the HTML fallback into QML.
